item.description: *ONE PAIR PER CUSTOMER orders of multiples will be cancelled without notice. *EXCLUDED FROM DISCOUNTS Due to limited release. *NO RETURNS Due to limited release. You can always count on a classic. This edition of the Dunk High comes to you in collaboration with premier Finnish skate shop, Beyond. The sockliner features blueprints of kidney pools, celebrating the adaptability of skaters through the decades. Made from premium leather, this iconic silhouette blends an old-school look with a comfortable feel. Ready to lace up? With extra laces included, you can have your pick." Leather upper softens and gains vintage character with wear. High-top collar, tongue shape and perforations on the toe box add an iconic look that stays true to the original. Rubber sole has a full cupsole stitch for exceptional durability. More Details High collar Foam midsole Rubber outsole Style # IU4491-100
